title: AI Lead Generation: Real Company Emails in Seconds
cover: In this video we are going to see how to generate leads with AI using LinkFinder AI.
payoff: That's Service Experts's real contact email: info at serviceexperts dot com, found in about three seconds. Go to the first link in the description to try it yourself.
outro: That's how to generate leads with AI, for one company or a whole list. Your next step: open the first link in the description and run your own list.
outroSub: Free account, credits included. First link in the description.

mocks._source: Real results from the LinkFinder AI API (data/lookups.json), checked by tools/gen360.py

click.text: I just need one lookup for now

steps.narration: Most email finders don't find a company's inbox. They guess one, stitching together info at, or contact at, and hoping it exists. That's why so many cold emails bounce. LinkFinder AI looks up the real value for the company you name. Here's exactly how, one click at a time.
Now the company website. Pick company website.
Same company, Service Experts. Enrich.
There it is: serviceexperts dot com.
Now the LinkedIn company page. Click Change. Pick LinkedIn company page.

click.text: A company's LinkedIn page, from its name

steps.narration: Same company, Service Experts. Enrich.
There it is: their official LinkedIn page.
Now the phone number. Click Change. Pick phone number.
Same company, Service Experts. Enrich.
Step one. Click Change, then click More searches.
Step two. Pick a company's contact email, from its name. It costs five credits.

click.text: A company's contact email, from its name

steps.narration: Step three. Type the company name: Service Experts.
Step four. Click Enrich Data.
There it is: info at serviceexperts dot com. The real one, not a guess.
Checking companies one at a time is fine for one pitch. For a whole list, click Change, pick the same lookup, and switch to Upload CSV.

click.text: A company's contact email, from its name

steps.narration: Select your file. One column of company names. Ours has 5.
You see every row before anything runs, so you know exactly what it costs.
Click Process 5 items.
Every row gets the exact same lookup. The contact emails fill in one by one.
5 companies in, 5 contact emails out, each marked Found. Export it as a CSV in one click.
Your list already lives in Google Sheets? The add-on runs the same lookups right in the column, no export, no re-import.
Want it in your own tools? Click API and MCP in the top menu. Same lookup, one call, the answer comes straight back.
And every lookup lands in History, so you can see what you found, when, and what it cost.
